_doc: ESS & Charging — grid storage integrators, inverters, charging. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

fluence.one_liner: Grid-scale ESS integrator (Siemens + AES JV origin).

chargepoint.one_liner: Large North American EV charging network operator.

ge renewable.one_liner: US renewables and grid-technology business; spun off (with GE's power businesses) into GE Vernova in 2024.

sma solar.one_liner: German solar inverter maker, also supplying battery-storage inverters.

delta electronics.one_liner: Taiwanese power-electronics group; EV charging and energy-storage systems.

abb.one_liner: Swiss-Swedish industrial-technology group; e-mobility and energy-storage systems.

pylontech.one_liner: Chinese maker of residential and commercial battery-storage systems.

kokam.one_liner: Korean NMC pouch-cell and energy-storage systems maker, part of SolarEdge.

leclanché.one_liner: Swiss battery-systems maker for marine and stationary storage applications.

enersys.one_liner: US industrial-battery maker; motive power, standby power and energy-storage systems.

sonnen.one_liner: German home battery-storage maker, acquired by Shell in 2019.

powin.one_liner: US integrator of utility-scale battery-storage systems.

hithium.one_liner: Chinese energy-storage cell maker, one of the fastest-growing ESS suppliers.

bp pulse.one_liner: EV charging network operated by BP.

fastned.one_liner: Dutch fast-charging network operator across Europe.

enel x.one_liner: EV charging arm (JuiceBox) of Italian utility Enel.

schneider electric.one_liner: French energy-management group; acquired EV Connect for charging-network software.

aulton.one_liner: Chinese battery-swapping operator, an early partner of NIO's swap network.

sun mobility.one_liner: Indian battery-swapping provider for two- and three-wheelers.

xcharge.one_liner: Chinese maker of high-power DC fast chargers.

teld.one_liner: One of China's largest EV charging network operators (Qingdao Teld New Energy).

gogoro.one_liner: Taiwanese battery-swapping platform for electric scooters.

ample.one_liner: US developer of modular battery-swapping technology for EVs.

wärtsilä.one_liner: Finnish technology group; grid-scale energy-storage systems alongside marine and energy solutions.

electrify america.one_liner: US DC fast-charging network, established by Volkswagen Group.

ionity.one_liner: European high-power charging network backed by several major automakers.

shell recharge solutions.one_liner: Shell's EV charging arm, formed from the Volta, Greenlots and NewMotion acquisitions.

blink charging.one_liner: US EV charging network and hardware maker, which acquired SemaConnect.

star charge.one_liner: Chinese EV charging network and hardware maker.
